cases.prompt: I have a GLB with plain gray materials at public/model.glb, make it look realistic
cases.expect: Reads the GLB's node names/extras before asking anything; asks only for visual style, delivery targets, interaction requirements, device tier, and licensing policy; writes and validates scene/brief.yaml against scene-brief.schema.json before finishing.

cases.prompt: Convert my IFC building export into a realistic web scene
cases.expect: Records input.kind as 'ifc' in the brief, does not assume a three.js source, and does not silently fall back to name-prefix classification rules later.
